Set.Author: Nikola Hristov
Set.Message:

- Aligns with Land project's goals of sustainable open collaboration while protecting core components
- Requires preservation of attribution and source code availability for LPL-licensed portions
- Includes compatibility appendix for potential integration with GPLv3+/AGPLv3+/MPL2.0 projects
